howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.

Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.

howToApply: Visit the official website www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link at the Home Page.
Register yourself by filling mandatory details: Advertisement No., Advertisement Date, Name of Applicant (as per matriculation certificate), Date of Birth, Mobile No. & Email ID.
After successful registration, an acknowledgement will be sent to your registered Email ID with User ID and Password.
Login using your credentials and click on ‘Go to Application Form’.

Fill the application form section-wise carefully, uploading all required documents (educational certificates from Matric onwards, category certificate, MCI/DCI registration, NOC from employer if applicable, etc.).
Upload a recent passport-size coloured photograph (taken on or after 01.10.2026) in JPEG format (50-80 KB), with your name and date of photograph clearly visible.
Pay the application fee online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (UPI may be avoided).
After successful payment, take a printout of the completed application form and e-Challan for your records.
Keep the hard copy of the application form along with all uploaded documents and e-Challan for submission when called upon by PGIMER.
